sinopsis.es: La protagonista, psicóloga penitenciaria, afronta el duelo por la muerte de su padre, a quien solo vio una vez en la vida. Además hereda una de sus deudas, lo que complica los sentimientos contradictorios que la abruman y las dificultades de la intimidad. Un drama introspectivo, glacial e inquietante sobre la soledad y el deseo reprimido.
sinopsis.en: The protagonist, a prison psychologist, grapples with grief over the death of her father, whom she saw only once in her life. She also inherits one of his debts, which complicates the conflicting emotions that overwhelm her and her difficulties with intimacy. An icy, disturbing, introspective drama about loneliness and repressed desire.
